entities.name: Kaylen
entities.description: A Dwarven hero of Sarpadia, lover of Tymolin Loneglade, killed by an orc during an Orc-Goblin invasion.

events.summary: An Orc-Goblin army invaded; Kaylen and Tymolin struggled to hold back the invaders.
events.quote: When an Orc - Goblin army invaded their homeland Tymolin and Kaylen struggled to hold back the waves of invaders.

events.summary: Kaylen was struck down from behind by an orc and died with Tymolin by his side.
events.quote: Kaylen was eventually struck down from behind by an orc

relations.quote: his lover was the human Tymolin Loneglade
